shared_elements: procession/frontal-facing bodies with profile heads (low relief)
figures carrying/holding objects in raised hands
low-relief carving with incised linear detail
justification: Both show profile human figures in low relief wearing long pleated robes and carrying handled vessels, and both include multi-petalled rosettes as an ancillary motif (a decorative border band in A, a stylized flowering plant in B), which is a fairly specific shared repertoire. However, A is a horizontal procession of several tribute-bearers leading a camel between ornamental bands, while B is a single large winged, bird-headed(?) figure with a bucket beside a sacred plant filling the whole panel, so the compositions and the central subjects differ substantially.
